entry.description: `LocalSyslogAppender` rejects a `NewLineHandling` other than `Escape`, `Split` or `Keep` on activation, as `RemoteSyslogAppender` does, so the appender logs nothing. A configuration with a number such as `5` ran as `Keep` until now, with raw line breaks (ANT-2026-6O92ZO65, fixed by @FreeAndNil)
